title: plugin-sharing: a member with more than 5000 share grants on one object silently loses access to the grants past 5000 (list misses rows, GET answers 404)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Filing gate: ① a reproducible defect, measured by the area S2 bench agent for epic #33631 R9 (report 6893177082 on #33701). It fails closed: access is lost, never gained.

## 维护者速读

- 问题:一个成员在同一个对象上被共享超过 5000 条记录时,超过 5000 的那部分共享静默失效:列表里少了这些记录,直接打开被共享的记录返回 404。
- 谁会遇到:共享量大的客户(大客户名单按团队共享、按规则批量共享)。今天没人报,但 #33683 的修复(每条规则一行共享)会让单个成员的共享行数变多,更早撞到这个上限。
- 建议:读权限不要先把共享 id 全读进内存再拼条件,改成数据库里的子查询(正是 epic #33631 的 R9),上限就不存在了。

## What happens (measured, SQLite, origin/main around d7e1a5aa)

- A member holds 6000 `sys_record_share` grants on `account` (7000 visible in total with ownership): the list returns 6000 instead of 7000, and `GET /api/v1/data/account/:id` of a granted account past the cut answers 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND.
- Control: with exactly 5000 grants every granted record is visible.

## Why

`SharingService#buildReadFilter` (and `buildWriteFilter`) read the recipient's share rows with `limit 5000` and turn them into an id list; rows past the limit are dropped with no error, notice or log.

## Expected

Every grant counts, whatever the count. Preferred shape: compile the share leaf as a database semi-join (`id IN (SELECT record_id FROM sys_record_share WHERE …)`), the R9 item of epic #33631 (addendum 6893156419), instead of a materialised id list. If a cap stays for a driver without semi-joins, it must refuse loudly, never drop silently.

## Reader

`domain:server` area A2 (plugin-sharing). Related: #33683 / PR #33771 (one share row per rule raises row counts per member; its review named this cap). Pins: 5000 and 5001+ grants, list and GET, both gates; ablate.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue sys_record_share 5000` and `5000 sharing buildReadFilter`: only #33683, #33701 and #33631, none covering this.
